name: ZeroPlayer
note: Online shop for official football merchandise (zeroplayer.it), AC Monza's sleeve sponsor from the 2026-27 kit; the wordmark on the shirt reads 'ZeroPlayer by 3R Sport'. Ownership not traced: no named owner found. Leads: zeroplayer.it's privacy policy names CAV. RIMAUDO GROUP S.R.L., Via Curtatone 4, 20037 Paderno Dugnano (MI) as data controller (https://zeroplayer.it/policies/privacy-policy, checked 2026-10-03); 3R Sport S.r.l. (Via San Luca 10, Milano; P.IVA 12731490152) publishes company data at https://3rsport.com/pages/dati-societari-20220304 and shares the Via Curtatone 4 operating address; 3R Sport's Instagram says 'dietro Zeroplayer c'è 3R Sport'. A company-register entry is not an owner (CONTRIBUTING.md), so no ownership claim was written. Shop operator shown on shop.acmonza.com footer: '© Copyright 2026 GTZ Distribution'.
